name: app_launcher_add

provenance.source: IDA sub_C4F2BDC entry forwards R0 to off_200EB058[1] registry lookup; sub_C527E38 callsite supplies u16 app ID (3.101.036 pattern-matched) (3.101.036 partial-16 match)

notes: This is not the descriptor registration function. The descriptor and pages must first be registered through app_install (sub_CA519AC/off_200EB060). The returned descriptor is passed to load_app_info, which creates the launcher record. Do not use the former descriptor-pointer prototype. Return semantics are not proven boolean.

promotion.device_probe: native-manager probe runs this on device
